title: Impact of Surprise Electoral Outcomes on Industry Returns
research_question: How do unexpected election results affect cumulative abnormal returns (CAR) in various industries? Specifically, we aim to understand the immediate impact of a surprise electoral outcome on industry-level financial performance.
data_description: The dataset consists of 60 industry-level observations, with columns including stock_id, event_day, ret, mkt_ret, and beta. The data captures daily stock returns around the time of the election, allowing for the calculation of cumulative abnormal returns (CAR) relative to market returns.
